remarks: Location, Location, Location!  This charming top-floor loft-style unit with a balcony in South Norwalk is just moments away from Soho shopping, the waterfront, The Maritime Aquarium, and a variety of dining and coffee spots. It's also just a 10-minute walk to the train station. Freshly painted with recently refinished hardwood floors throughout, high ceilings, oversized windows, and plenty of natural light, this unit is a true gem. Enjoy central cooling and an additional 40 square feet of balcony space. The kitchen features brand-new appliances and plenty of space to cook. With generous closet space, an in-unit washer and dryer, and a relaxing balcony perfect for your morning coffee, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!  The unit is listed as 696 sq ft in public records (loft style), but currently measures 540 sq ft, plus 40 sq ft of balcony space.
